QuestInfo.name: Too Hot!
QuestInfo.0: Boy... The weather is hotter than ever!
QuestInfo.1: #b#p9270061##k says that the villagers need more of those #b#t4000465#s#k to cool themselves down.
QuestInfo.2: The villagers are happy now with their nice cool coconut juice! Icy refreshment was exactly what they needed.

0.0: Too hot! Too hot! We need more iced beverages or we're all going to sweat ourselves into puddles!
0.1: And here you are, just in time to save the village! Can you please help me collect more #b#t4000465#s#k? The villagers and I will perish without something to combat this blasted heat!

yes.0: Wonderful! You can easily get what we need by hunting #b#o9420527#s#k!

no.0: Well, the fact that you're alive means you enjoyed the delicious taste of the coconut juice I made for your last time. Will you really deprive us?

1.0: I don't know how you managed to do it in all this heat, but my villagers and I owe you our lives!

yes.0: Nothing quenches a person's thirst like the refreshing feel of coconut sliding down your throat... Ah!

item.0: You need to beat #b50 #o9420527#s#k collect #b100 #t4000465#s#k! I know it's hot, but I'm begging you!
